purpose: Bounded action-dependent service-control extension; separate from original static-label evaluation.

inspection.intent: Inspect infrastructure while preserving useful video delivery; avoid unnecessary fallback when video and safety evidence are weak.

emergency.intent: Recover emergency C2 service and preserve Remote-ID continuity; prioritize safety over payload video throughput.

utility: 10*(mission_c2_weight*max(clipped_positive_deadline_excess,c2_drop_fraction)+mission_video_weight*clipped_target_video_shortfall)+original_action_overhead+switch_penalty*I(action!=previous_action). Each fraction in [0,1], both mission weights sum to 1; same utility unit throughout.

policies.guarded_H1: Top-two marginal cause repair actions, Observe and FallbackProtect; current belief expected one-step service utility.
policies.candidate_H2: Same bounded action grammar at each observed belief-tree node, exact H=2 evaluation and per-step revalidation.
policies.full_library_H2: All six actions at each node, exact H=2 constrained belief-tree evaluation. Receding horizon, no future seed/noise access.
policies.generated_sequence_H2: Optional fixed sequence_policies.json, separately per generation replicate; first action restricts second action to submitted continuations; next-step guards and mission update applied. Execute first action and replan each step.

belief: New categorical belief over mechanism modes, not the original DES cause-label classifier. Eight likelihood outcomes integrated exactly. Action-dependent queues are conditioned upon before mode transition and new sensor observation.

analysis.primary: Episode cumulative service utility difference versus full_library_H2 at switch cost .2
analysis.reporting: Two-sided percentile 95% descriptive paired intervals; no selection by favorable direction, no global optimal-regret claim. Per-window full-information minima are never summed.

interaction.offered_video_noise: independent equiprobable 0.9 or 1.1 multiplier per window; same draw for all four conditions and all six policies
interaction.uncertainty: Episode-level paired bootstrap of interaction contrast. No fitted interaction correction or external physical-validation claim.

scope: Finite service queues and controller settings; parameters originating in old config and newly prescribed action effects are explicitly distinguished. No external physical validation or aircraft dynamics claim.
